caption:
Write the email now, send it at the right time. ⏰

In Gmail: click the arrow next to Send, then choose Schedule send.

Great for late-night drafts and reminders. 📌 Save this.

Follow @techmendly for a new tech tip every day.

#gmail #productivity #emailtips #timemanagement #worksmarter #lifehack #workfromhome #emailproductivity #techtips #techmendly

scenes.text: Writing emails at midnight? Don't send them then.
scenes.say: Writing emails at midnight? Do not send them then. Schedule them instead.

scenes.title: Schedule send
items: Click the arrow next to Send
scenes.say: Write your email as normal. Click the small arrow next to Send. Choose Schedule send.

scenes.title: Pick your time
scenes.say: Pick a ready-made time, or set your own date and time. That is it. It sends itself.

scenes.label: you can unschedule it before it sends
scenes.say: Bonus, you can cancel a scheduled email before it sends.
